cleaner.label: virtualenv (Python)
cleaner.description: virtualenv application data: seed wheels and install images reused to create environments. Does not touch environments already created.

option.label: virtualenv cache
option.description: Removes the cached wheels and install images.
option.warning: Recreated the next time a virtual environment is created. Environments created with `--symlink-app-data` link their packages to this folder and stop working.
